summary: Eagle Financial Services (EFSI), parent of Bank of Clarke, filed an 8-K disclosing a September 7, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with John Marshall Bancorp (JMSB). EFSI shareholders receive 2.00 JMSB shares per EFSI share, a stock-for-stock exchange ratio with cash for fractional shares, structured as a two-step merger plus a bank merger of Bank of Clarke into John Marshall Bank. Both boards approved unanimously; the deal is intended as a tax-free Section 368(a) reorganization, with EFSI restricted stock vesting at target. Watch regulatory approvals, shareholder votes and any exchange-ratio adjustment for deal spread.
